stem.text: An oil drop of mass $2.6 \times 10^{-15}\,\text{kg}$ and with a charge of $-4.8 \times 10^{-19}\,\text{C}$ is in a vacuum between two horizontal plates. The plates have a separation of $2.0\,\text{cm}$ and a potential difference (p.d.) between them of $1200\,\text{V}$, as shown.

stem.alt: Two horizontal parallel plates with a wire to the upper plate labelled +1200 V and a wire to the lower plate labelled 0 V, an oil drop between them, and a dimension of 2.0 cm between the plates.

stem.text: Which statement describes the motion of the oil drop?

B.text: It has a downward acceleration of $9.7\,\text{m s}^{-2}$.

C.text: It has an upward acceleration of $1.3\,\text{m s}^{-2}$.

D.text: It has an upward acceleration of $11\,\text{m s}^{-2}$.
